title: The finitude of the fibers of the complementary Bell numbers
summary: Subbarao and Verma introduced, in 1999, a number of open problems concerning the sequence $(f(n))_{n \geq 0}$ of complementary Bell numbers, which may be defined via Bell polynomials $B_{n}(x) = \sum_{k=0}^{n} \left\{ \begin{smallmatrix} n \\ k \end{smallmatrix} \right\} x^k$ so that $f(n) = B_{n}(-1)$. Yang [Electron. J. Combin., 2001] subsequently solved the first two problems from Subbarao and Verma, but the third such problem has remained open, to the best of our knowledge.
